source: segmentation (Blender simulation, background replaced by white)
units: pixels, seconds; image coords x right, y down

camera.evidence: pure white background, no texture; nothing to pan against; 2D scene with motion in a plane facing the camera

objects.name: ball
objects.description: single small olive/dark-yellow-green shaded sphere (RGB core ~ (80,87,6)); the only object in the video
objects.reference_point: intensity-weighted centroid of the ball mask (= sphere centre / object origin)

diameter_px.note: mask horizontal extent is ~1 px larger than vertical (slight motion blur / antialiasing); use ~25 px (vertical extent / equivalent diameter) as the ball diameter

objects.motion: straight horizontal line to the right at constant y ~ 564.15 px; speed decreases steadily (decelerating)

events.event: ball already moving at frame 0 (no visible start/release)
ball still moving (decelerating, not stopped) at last frame; does not leave frame
no bounce, impact, contact or direction change observed

perspective: none (2D scene, plain background); a single metres-per-pixel scale applies
